recs.title: Deal-closing actions
items: New 14 Oct: Aramco hyperspectral (#2206 / #2087) is moving. HySpex VS-620 budgetary offer sent 13 Oct; CHC and Optosky asked for dealer quotes; formal FS-6B end-user quote requested from CHNSpec this morning (reseller: DR). Choose the configuration and DR margin once the FS-6B quote is in. This replaces the 'stale 19 days' line below.

New 14 Oct: RFP #452, 15 Leica monitoring total stations (TS15/TS16 1", TM30/TM50/TS60 0.5", valid to 13 Nov). Match it to the ETASE TM50s (#3733) and our stock, and have Mireille post the offers. The MS60 seller in Norway declined to list outside the Nordics (13 Oct).

New 13 Oct, start here: Jimmy S00407 (€47,933). On 12 Oct he asked for €16,500/unit instead of €19,500 and to have it confirmed by you. S00404 was cancelled and S00407 re-issued. He plans to pay by Wed 21 Oct. Confirm the price to him and settle the MS60 unit question (Auksjonen case 8207673). It's first because it's the largest deal with a payment date this month.
New 13 Oct: RFP #449 Trimble SPS930. 4K Equipment confirmed overnight that their kit is available with machine control. Get their price and have Mireille post the offer.
New 13 Oct: Dubai Municipality asked for a drone-project status update (12 Oct). Reply today.

Start here: the Leica MS60 to Jimmy (€49,500, booked in the Cockpit on 8 Oct). Auksjonen.no registered José's return request for lot 576689 on 10 Oct (case 8207673, 4–5 business days to answer). Confirm which MS60 goes to Jimmy and which 3 are offered to Liang before anything ships, then have the Odoo sale order created. It's first because it's the largest booked sale this month and there's an open question on the unit.

Hyperspectral #2087 ($460k): Mapping Solutions answered all 8 of your questions on 11 Oct. Turnkey and flight-ready, 25–30 min endurance (about 1 km² in 2 h at 120 m), PPK recommended (Bifrost real-time mineral ID is €40k extra), PARGE + DroCor perpetual with €1,500/yr maintenance each, 1-year warranty (+15% per extra year), and 4–6 months delivery plus 4–6 months for the export licence (end-user statement needed). Build the client proposal and set DR's reseller margin this week.

RFPs we can fill from stock (Mireille posts the offers): #443 TS15 expires Sat 17 Oct, #445 total station (€8k budget, 22 Oct), #448 TX8 and the new #450 Emlid RS4 (Georges' buyer). #442 TS11 expired yesterday with 0 offers, the third stock-matched RFP to lapse unanswered in four days.

Email deliverability. On 12 Oct you told Levit that @topotrade.com mail lands in spam because SPF/DKIM/DMARC records are missing in Route 53. Every quote, RFP alert and nudge we send is affected, so get a date for the fix from Ali.
ETASE TM50s (#3733): pay the £8,500 for S/N 370163 (ready the week of 19 Oct) and decide on the other 4. Then keep one TM50 quote for Jimmy: S00392 (€13,300, yours) or S00400 ($15,140, Georges).
Liang, 3× MS60 (#3647, €54k): still only a holiday auto-reply. Follow up this week, and keep WH/OUT/00088 on hold until invoice 1715 (€29,900) is paid.
Stale, 19 days: Aramco #2206 ($566k). No CRM activity since 23 Sep. Worth a call, not another email.
Al-Sudoof (#3497): his $3,500 / $3,800 counter is below cost. Give Claude a floor price or close it.
Routing to decide: 39 quotes (≈$458k) still sit under 'Contact', including EF2I S00372 (€83,333, 18 business days) and S00401 Crowley (sold, so it goes to Mireille).
Your pipeline: 29 open opportunities, $1,341,540 expected revenue. Team-wide: 340 open opportunities, ≈$2.46M expected revenue (293 New · 21 Qualified · 26 Proposition).
